title: Cinnamon Sugar Doughnut Muffins
changes_from_base: A nutmeg-scented creamed batter with no fruit; the warm muffins are brushed with melted butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar like a doughnut.
summary: Nutmeg-scented muffins brushed with butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar, like baked doughnuts.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan) and grease the tin generously so the muffins come out cleanly.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Beat the soft butter, oil, caster sugar and brown sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in the baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, nutmeg, salt and vanilla.

steps.title: Alternate
steps.text: Stir in a third of the flour, then half the milk, another third of flour, the rest of the milk and the last of the flour. Scrape down the bowl and mix until even.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Fill the holes nearly to the top and bake 15-17 min, until golden and a cocktail stick comes out clean.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Mix the granulated sugar and cinnamon in a shallow bowl. Ease the warm muffins out, brush each all over with melted butter and roll in the cinnamon sugar.

tips: The most common mistake is coating them cold; the sugar only sticks while they are warm.
Freshly grated nutmeg gives the true doughnut taste.
Grease the tin well rather than using cases, so the sides take the coating.
storage: Best on the day. Keep in an airtight box for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
